packageRules.description: Base image and Debian package pins are coupled: the suite determines which package versions exist, so they move together.
Look up Bookworm packages (including updates and security when Renovate supports their xz indexes). Debian releases have no timestamps, so disable the release-age check.
prBodyNotes: Debian packages do not provide release timestamps to Renovate, so the minimum release age is not enforced.

packageRules.description: Track gh from GitHub releases instead of the Debian package index.
gh and the pi coding agent are independent of the OS layer; keep them in one small PR of their own.
